Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Robb Wynn writes:
> Methuselah In Training that is...
>
> 1) It says in the rules (6.3.3 Gaining Votes) that
> "Each Methuselah may gain one vote by using a political action card".
>
> Is the Methuselah who called the vote allowed to burn a political card to
> get his/her extra vote (in addition to the +1 vote on the card)?

No (since you're assuming that the referendum was called with a
political action card).

6.3.3:
"If a political action card was used to call the referendum, that
card provides a vote for the acting vampire's controller."
and
"Each Methuselah can gain no more than one vote from political action
cards"

> ...or can you ONLY GAIN ONE EXTRA VOTE through use of a political card
> whether you're the one who called the vote or not?

Correct, although the "extra" probably shouldn't be there.

> 2) When calling a Blood Hunt, does the Methuselah calling it get +1 vote
> automatically?

No, since "this referendum is handled just like any other" (6.5.6.)

> Can you burn a political card to get a vote?

Yes, since "this referendum is handled just like any other" (6.5.6.)
